release_notes:
Add reference-based username/email matching to the Wise reconciler

Wise deposits carry a sender payment reference, same as Zelle memos, but the Wise
reconciler never looked at it -- only an explicit GSMF-<id> reference or a pure
amount+timing guess could credit an invoice. A deposit whose reference named the
account by username or email, with no matching pending invoice (or only an old,
already-closed one), had no path to get credited automatically.

Added the same pass the Zelle reconciler already has: an exact username or email
match in the reference is trusted enough to credit a pending invoice at that
amount, or auto-create one if none exists, same as an admin would by hand. The
username/email extraction helper moved from zelle_reconcile.php into functions.php
so both reconcilers share one implementation.
